exposure: reasons for undertaking current SSI surveillance
priority surgical categories for future SSI surveillance
outcome: ranked priority surgical categories for future SSI surveillance
cohort: Infection control teams from acute NHS trusts in England participated in a web-based survey.
finding: Assessment of quality of care was the most common driver for SSI surveillance, and although priorities varied, caesarean section was the highest-ranked priority for future surveillance not currently included in the national programme.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was identified as one of the highest-ranked priority surgical categories for future SSI surveillance.
